baseline_sources.source_context: TechRadar reported a Claude partial outage beginning around 07:10 GMT. Claude Status reported elevated Opus 4.6 errors while the reporter also observed Sonnet 4.6 hanging. During the outage, the free-plan interface displayed an unexpected-capacity message and suggested upgrading to Pro. A fix was implemented by about 10:58 GMT and the status page showed all systems operational by about 11:59 GMT.
